A 293
2018 Non-Biodegradable Waste Control (Plastic SRO. 19
Bags) Order
GRENADA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS NO. 19 OF 2018
The Minister in exercise of the powers conferred on him by Section 3
(2) of the Non-Biodegradable Waste Control Act, No. 9 of 2018
hereby makes the following Order–
(Gazetted 14th September, 2018).
1. Citation. This Order may be cited as the–
NON-BIODEGRADABLE WASTE CONTROL (PLASTIC
BAGS) ORDER, 2018.
2. Definitions. In this Order–
“Act” means the Non-Biodegradable Waste Control Act, No. 9 of 2018;
“plastic shopping bags” means any single-use shopping bag with handles and
made of plastic.
3. Designation of plastic shopping bags. For the purposes of the Act, a plastic
shopping bag is a non-biodegradable product.
4. Transitional provisions.—(1) Section 4 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect
to plastic shopping bags from the 1st day of February, 2019.
(2) Section 5 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect to plastic shopping bags
from the 1st day of December, 2019.
(3) Section 6 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect to plastic shopping bags
from the 1st day of February, 2020.
A 294
SRO. 19 Non-Biodegradable Waste Control (Plastic 2018
Bags) Order
Made by the Minister this 30th day of August, 2018.
SIMON STIELL
Minister with responsibility for the Environment.
GRENADA
